description: ADO-BATCH staging on a client static batch-optimistic Recordset of SELECT ID, Code, L, S FROM T ORDER BY ID: read Status at row 1; set S and read Status and EditMode before and after Update; AddNew, set Code, read Status and EditMode, Update, read Status; Delete of row 3 (Status, EditMode, reading S, MoveNext, Status, RecordCount); then every row's Status and ID, again under Filter = adFilterPendingRecords (RecordCount), and after CancelBatch(adAffectAll) (rows, RecordCount). Asks the Status values of staged, new and deleted rows and what a deleted row exposes.
retentionNote: Designed r-ado-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
